skill_name: Find a quote in the article that relates to the theme of work-life balance.
workflow: In the recent survey, the World Economic Forum noted that organizations “need to move beyond utilizing short-term, narrowly focused strategies to address work-life balance, and to consider the long-term and systemic possibilities for creating balance within their organizations.” This quote highlights the importance of organizations recognizing worker wellbeing, rather than just focusing on the performance and productivity of the organization.
